[IALC.3.5] **The regex engine is not routed.** RE2, Abseil, libds's C++
seam over them, and the C++ standard library they use allocate through C++'s
global `operator new` and `operator delete`, not through the layer. Neither
mode of [IALC.1.2] reaches that memory. libds must not define a global
`operator new` or `operator delete` to reach it: either would replace the
integrator's for their whole program. This is the documented coverage gap of
[IALC.3.3].

The engine allocates there in three places:

| When | What allocates |
|---|---|
| Loading an artefact | One compiled pattern per distinct regex, freed with the engine |
| A match, during a pump | RE2's match cache. libds sets no budget for it, so RE2's default per-pattern budget bounds it |
| A capture, during a pump | The submatch array, freed before the capture returns |

A build without an RE2-class engine ([LNRE.4.1]) has no such gap.
